Order by virtue of the power vested in me under the Provisions of the Provincial Councils (ConsequentialProvisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, read with the Provisions of the Co-operative Societies Act, No. 05 of 1972 andas amended under the Provisions of the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1992 and Act, No. 32 of 1983

R. P. D. Gunadasa Dehigama, Provincial Minister of Road, Transport, Co-operatives, Trade, Housing and Construction,Rural Industries Development and Rural Development of North Western Provincial Council, do hereby delegate thepower vested with the Commissioner and the Registrar of Co-operative Development of the North Western ProvincialCouncil, under the Provisions of the Co-operative Societies Act, No. 05 of 1972 as amended under the Provisions of theCo-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11 vof 1992 and Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the rules framed thereunder,thereafter, as per Column III and from the date as per Column II to the persons named as per Column I, to assist theCommissioner and the Registrar of Co-operative Development of the North Western Province.

R. P. D. GUNADASA DEHIGAMA,Provincial Minister of Road, Transport, Co-operatives,Trade, Housing and Construction, Rural Industries Developmentand Rural Development of North Western Province Provincial Council.
